content.study:
Section 20 — Place of arbitration

Section 20 permits parties to agree on the place of arbitration. Failing agreement, the tribunal determines the place having regard to the circumstances and convenience of the parties. The tribunal may meet elsewhere for specified purposes such as hearing witnesses or inspecting property, unless the parties agree otherwise.

Apply the provision by identifying its operative conditions, procedural stage, connected statutory provisions and precise consequence. Do not substitute generic arbitration practice for the statutory rule.
